prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you want a short vetted list of roofers near you, or general guidance on how to pick the best one? If you want local recommendations, tell me your Denver ZIP code or neighborhood and whether you’re filing an insurance claim.

Meanwhile, here are quick, practical tips for choosing the best roofer for hail-damage repair:

What to look for
- Local storm/insurance experience: Hail-season experience and regular work with insurance adjusters is important.
- Certifications: Look for manufacturer certifications (GAF Master Elite, CertainTeed SELECT, Owens Corning Platinum) — they indicate training and warranty options.
- Licensing & insurance: Verify Colorado license (if required for the job), current liability insurance and workers’ comp.
- Written estimate & scope: Get a detailed, line-item estimate (materials, labor, tear-off vs. overlays, disposal, timeline).
- Warranties: Ask about workmanship warranty and how long it lasts, and whether manufacturer shingle warranties transfer.
- References & reviews: Check Google, Yelp, Angi, and BBB ratings; ask for recent local references.
- Storm-chasing warning: Avoid knock-on “storm chasers” who pressure you immediately after a storm. Prefer established local companies with a physical address.

Questions to ask every roofer
- Are you licensed and insured? Can you provide certificates?
- Are you manufacturer-certified? Which brands?
- Do you handle insurance claims/meet with the adjuster?
- Will the estimate include photos and an itemized damage report?
- Who will coordinate the permit and inspection?
- What is your warranty on labor and materials?

Red flags
- High-pressure sale tactics, “we’ll get everything paid for” claims
- Requests for large upfront cash payment (get a written contract with staged payments)
- No physical address or opaque contract terms
- Vague estimates instead of itemized proposals

If you want, give me your ZIP code or address neighborhood and I’ll pull a short list (3–5) of top-rated Denver roofers for hail repair, including links, ratings, and a recommended pick based on certifications, reviews, and insurance experience. Which would you prefer?
